resources.string: Remove this receipt when you save the expense? The existing image remains attached until Save succeeds.
Optional: scan a receipt, review its image and choose whether to use the detected total. Scanning never saves an expense.
Review the receipt and expense amount. Attachment changes take effect only when you save the expense.
Please check the receipt before using this amount.
No unambiguous payable total was found. Enter or correct the expense amount manually; the receipt can still be attached.
Text recognition was unavailable. Enter the amount manually; the receipt image is still ready to attach.
Could not process or store this capture. Your previous attachment is preserved. Retake a clear, shorter image or enter the amount manually.
Camera permission was denied. Allow it in Android settings to scan, or continue with manual expense entry.
No camera could complete the capture. You can still enter the expense manually.
Capture cancelled. The previous receipt and amount are unchanged.
Receipt marked for removal. Save the expense to apply this change.
Receipt unavailable. Retry, replace it or remove it while editing the expense.
Pinch to zoom; drag to read the full receipt. Zoom buttons are also available.
The receipt has conflicting or uncertain total information. Enter the payable amount manually after checking the receipt.
